resolvedFindings.before: Stored completion/help labels could conflict with visible solutions, wrong answers or incompatible result types and still claim independent success.
resolvedFindings.fix: Restoration verifies answer and completed step prefix, infers help from surviving evidence, reconciles status conservatively and treats incompatible old labels as familiar work.

resolvedFindings.before: Detached repeat/reset callbacks could mutate old work and redraw the wrong view after navigation.
resolvedFindings.fix: Mutating handlers and links check rendering epoch and hash; task callbacks also verify current progress identity.

resolvedFindings.before: After hint/reveal work, topic reset erased familiarity and allowed the same task to claim first independent completion.
resolvedFindings.fix: Reset preserves familiarity from help, attempts, completed steps, hints, revealed steps and prior completion.

resolvedFindings.before: Activating the keyboard skip link followed #main; the SPA treated that hash as the home route and left the current task.
resolvedFindings.fix: The early skip-link click handler prevents hash navigation, focuses main and optionally scrolls it into view.
resolvedFindings.independentRetest: PASS: exact task hash, condition, draft and saved state unchanged; main receives focus and scrollIntoView({block: start}) is called once. Expanded DOM suite passes with the new regression.
resolvedFindings.realKeyboardTestReview: Chromium test now focuses .skip-link and presses Enter, then checks unchanged task URL and main focus. Test implementation independently reviewed; root is running Chromium.

limits: Review is code inspection plus Node/jsdom and exact answer probes. The independent reviewer did not rerun Chromium; root is performing final Chromium layout/learner-flow verification against these guards.

Local browser progress is a learning record, not an authenticated examination or a claim about pupil mastery. Account/cloud synchronization and simultaneous-tab conflict resolution are outside this task.
Real pupil comprehension and assistive technology testing are not established by these automated checks.

reportedProviderFailure.provenance: Provider failure identified by root and referenced by workflow hold; this code reviewer did not make a provider request or independently refetch the run log.

isolatedBehaviorProbe.method: Ran current main() with TEXTBOOK_MODE and a hold value, isolated artifact directory, real committed public review material and a urlopen trap. The hold wrote the unavailable artifact and exited before any provider request.

workflowChecks: The actual external-review job remains enabled for the task branch.
The job runs external-review.py without --prepare-only and without continue-on-error or an exit-zero wrapper.
The hold is passed to the task branch and raises SystemExit with a nonempty failure reason.
Artifact upload uses always(); it records unavailability, never APPROVE.
